I am a data scientist based in Valencia, Spain, finishing an MSc in Data Science
at the Universitat Oberta de Catalunya. I work on applied machine learning and
deep learning: predictive models on educational data, an open housing dataset
published with a DOI, and human activity recognition from sensor time series.

Before data, I spent ten years as a physiotherapist and a vocational teacher,
turning complex information into decisions for people without a technical
background — in clinics, in professional sport and in the classroom. That is
still the part of the work I care about most: a model nobody can act on is not
finished.

## Selected projects

[**Alicante Housing Market Analysis**](projects/alicante-housing/index.qmd) —
an end-to-end pipeline over 1,802 property listings, from scraping to
geospatial enrichment, gradient boosting with SHAP and hypothesis testing.
Released as an open dataset with a DOI.

[**ED-Alert**](projects/ed-alert/index.qmd) — early school leaving across
Spanish regions against the European ELET indicator, combined with PISA 2022
data to surface the strongest predictors of dropout risk. Delivered as an
interactive Tableau story for guidance counsellors.
